mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses equity discount rates through sustained monetary easing, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as observed in historical easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% triggers fiscal stimulus and monetary accommodation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate policy response.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates consumer spending shift toward services, boosting equity valuations over 60-day horizon through sector rotation.
failure_condition: Joint signal (HOUST decline + RSAFS rise) produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 1.0% quarterly signals manufacturing recovery, increasing corporate earnings visibility and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days during post-recession phases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO growth > 1.0% quarterly.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls growth exceeding 100k monthly indicates sustained labor market strength, supporting consumer spending and corporate margins for positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS growth > 100k.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days through rising discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate increase combined with declining CPI year-over-year change indicates successful inflation control without recession, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Joint signal (FEDFUNDS rise + CPIAUCSL YoY decline) produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth exceeding 2.0% quarterly during early expansion phases validates economic momentum, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with GDPC1 growth > 2.0% quarterly.
